import copy, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.dispatcher import export

rows = [{"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "extra": "x"}, {"id": None, "name": 2.5}, {"name": "Zoë"}]
assert export_rows(rows, "csv") == "id,name\n1,Alice\n,2.5\n,Zoë\n"
assert export_rows(rows, "json") == '[{"id":"1","name":"Alice"},{"id":"","name":"2.5"},{"id":"","name":"Zoë"}]'
assert export_csv(rows) == export_rows(rows, "csv")
assert export_json(rows) == export_rows(rows, "json")
assert export([], "csv") == "id,name\n" and export([], "json") == "[]"
assert export_csv(iter([{"id": 1, "name": "a"}])) == "id,name\n1,a\n"
assert export_json(iter([{"id": 1, "name": "a"}])) == '[{"id":"1","name":"a"}]'
assert export_csv([{"id": 'q"x', "name": "a,b"}]) == 'id,name\n"q""x","a,b"\n'
before = copy.deepcopy(rows)
export_rows(rows, "csv"); export_rows(rows, "json")
assert rows == before
for bad in ["xml", "CSV", None]:
    try:
        export_rows([], bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"expected ValueError for {bad!r}")
print("EXPORTER_CHECKS_OK")
